summary: A letter sealed with a passphrase; without it the words are gibberish.
text: Write on this sheet, then seal it with a Magic action and a passphrase you speak or sign. Anyone who opens it without saying the phrase sees only unreadable scrawl.

params.text: seals the letter with your passphrase
